summary: Completed MVP API and UI verification. Backend routes, auth, dashboard data, DEMO SAR analysis/history, optional routes, and FastAPI docs passed. Desktop login, map, analysis action, logout, and test-id uniqueness passed. Mobile dashboard renders, but mobile logout is inaccessible because the sidebar is hidden.

integration_issues.issue: Logout button is inside the sidebar, while responsive CSS hides aside at max-width 900px; authenticated mobile users have no visible way to sign out.

issues: Sidebar is display:none, including the only logout control; provide a mobile logout/menu control.

action_items: Expose logout on mobile, or add a visible mobile menu/account control containing logout, then retest at 390px width.
critical_code_review_comments: Frontend call() does not include a loading/error abstraction for every action; the flood analysis handler can reject without displaying a controlled error notice, though the tested success path works.
seed_data_creation: No new seed data; used preloaded admin and North Meadow DEMO field.
context_for_next_testing_agent: Public preview tested with admin@example.com/admin123. Backend 3/3 pytest tests passed. Desktop and mobile dashboard/map verified; only mobile logout remains unresolved. DEMO SAR, weather, soil, crop readiness, and seed analysis are intentionally MOCKED/DEMO per product scope.
rca of the issue: At viewport width 390px, App.css media query sets aside{display:none}; logout-button is rendered only within aside in Dashboard, so Playwright resolves it but cannot click it. Add a responsive account/logout control outside the hidden sidebar or change mobile navigation behavior.
